domains.label: Language Models
domains.modalityBasis: Vision2Code uses images and language/code. General-purpose user simulation and LLM post-training involve language; post-training also includes code generation. FRAMES monitoring additionally uses robot proprioception and contact feedback; touch denotes contact feedback rather than tactile imaging.
domains.basis: CV-based approximation: DukeNLP, Sep 2025-Nov 2026 (15 calendar months). Author estimate: 2 months on general-purpose user simulators, treated as part of this DukeNLP period rather than additional months. LLM post-training, Feb-Apr 2026 (3 months), and FRAMES, May-Nov 2026, overlap and add no months.

domains.modalityBasis: FRAMES uses multi-view visual observations, language, proprioception, and contact feedback. SkillBlenderLC uses language-conditioned humanoid control. Touch denotes contact feedback.
